response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, matched_count, 1.0 * matched_count / SUM(matched_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM counts ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: High peer correlation means strictly greater than 0.149.

alternatives.interpretation: Include records whose peer correlation equals the cutoff.
